name: maxim
description: Behavioral intelligence layer for Claude.ai Cowork. Multi-agent framework with 7 executive offices + 91 specialist agents, 78 behavioral frameworks, 14 compliance frameworks, 37 skill domains, 48 slash commands (TIER 1 verb-first + TIER 2 office + TIER 3 persona + domain/workflow), 8 MCP connectors (49 tools total incl. new mxm-commands dispatcher), 13 Proactive Watch drift classes. Ships ~85% fidelity of the full Claude Code deployment.

mcp_connectors.name: mxm-voice
mcp_connectors.note: No-op unless voicemode binary is available in the Cowork runtime

mcp_connectors.name: mxm-commands
mcp_connectors.note: Slash-command dispatcher — exposes all 48 /mxm-* commands as MCP tools. Provides command parity for surfaces lacking native slash-command processors (Desktop, Web, Cowork).

non_negotiable.description: The following govern Maxim behavior and cannot be disabled or bypassed by plugin customizers.
items: CSO auto-loop on security / compliance / PII signals
Confidence tagging on every substantive output

governance.notes: Plugin deployments can't enforce critical-contract blocking (no pre-commit hook in Cowork). Use Code CLI for enforcement-grade governance.
